title: VisionBar
description: VisionBar - It will broadcast every 3 minutes on boss-bar
body:
# 🔮 VisionBar – Stylish Action Bar Effects for Players
VisionBar is a lightweight and powerful Minecraft plugin that displays custom messages on a rainbow Boss Bar for all players. It features adjustable intervals, startup messages, update notifications for admins, and simple commands to reload or view help. Perfect for servers looking to add style, alerts, or announcements in a sleek, non-intrusive way
